name: Baby Daisy
text: You text in all caps and consider it a personality trait. Youngest sibling energy even if you're an only child. Will start drama at brunch and post about it before the check arrives.

name: Baby Luigi
text: Crippling middle child energy. Unironically describes himself as 'just a guy.' Eats cereal for dinner three nights a week and has no plans to change.

name: Baby Mario
text: Thinks he's the main character but he's actually a side quest. Wears a backwards cap indoors. Says he's '6'1 on a good day' and he is not.

name: Baby Peach
text: Aggressively pink. Drinks an energy drink before noon and calls it self care. 30 years old and still calls herself babygirl, which, fair.

name: Baby Rosalina
text: Reads horoscopes ironically and then changes plans because of them. Owns at least three crystals she can't explain. Mercury retrograde absolutely IS your fault, actually.

name: Bowser
text: Goes to the gym and posts about it. Manages a chain restaurant or wants to. Will fight a stranger about a sports team. Surprisingly excellent dad.

name: Bowser Jr.
text: Daddy issues with extra steps. Plays the drums badly but loudly. Has 'menace' in his bio and means it. We are rooting for him.

name: Cat Peach
text: Cosplayer. Owns a Wacom tablet that hasn't been opened in months. Started a podcast nobody asked for and is, against all odds, kind of good at it.

name: Donkey Kong
text: Salt of the earth. Owns one good pair of jeans. Will help you move for a single pizza and a six pack. The friend group's emotional load bearing wall.

name: Dry Bones
text: Quiet. Carries the team. Plays support in every game and quietly resents you for never thanking him. Has been your roommate for four years and you know nothing about him.

name: Dry Bowser
text: Goth phase that never ended, just got refined. Listens to metal earnestly. Has a tattoo with Latin on it. Reads more books than you do, by a wide margin.

name: Iggy
text: Theater kid all grown up. Takes mushrooms at festivals and talks about it for weeks. Genuinely reads Vonnegut and will tell you about it whether you asked or not.

name: Inkling Boy
text: TikTok poster. Skateboards once a season. Wears Crocs unironically and looks good doing it, which is unfair to the rest of us.

name: Inkling Girl
text: Pinterest aesthetic core. Drinks matcha and is a different person before vs. after. Owns a Polaroid camera with the same cartridge from 2019 still in it.

name: Isabelle
text: Anxious people pleaser. Sends 'no worries if not!' attached to a 5 paragraph request. Cries quietly in the bathroom at the office holiday party. Beloved by all.

name: King Boo
text: Lurker. Reads every message in the group chat and never replies. Suspicious browser history. Will show up to the function unannounced and leave without saying bye.

name: Koopa Troopa
text: Nice. Boring. The friend who suggests Applebee's for the birthday dinner. Reliable in a way that makes you a little sad sometimes.

name: Lakitu
text: Camera person at every event. Posts the unflattering BeReal at 3am on purpose. Will absolutely make a documentary about your friend group that nobody asked for.

name: Larry
text: Skater archetype. Probably needs an Adderall script and won't get one. The charm is doing 80% of the work and somehow it's still working.

name: Lemmy
text: Class clown who never grew out of it. Does crowd work at parties. Genuinely chaotic in a way that costs you money about once a year.

name: Link
text: Min maxer. Has a spreadsheet for grocery shopping. Played Breath of the Wild for 200 hours and 'didn't really get into it.' He is lying.

name: Ludwig
text: Pretentious in a way you secretly enjoy. Owns a record player and a French press. Will explain mezcal to you like you didn't ask. You did not ask.

name: Luigi
text: Anxious. Loyal. The friend who texts to make sure you got home safe. Second fiddle complex masking a genuinely beautiful soul. We don't deserve him.

name: Mario
text: You picked the default. Probably a centrist. Voted for the same thing your parents did and didn't think too hard about it. We respect the consistency, mostly.

name: Metal Mario
text: Tryhard. Plays only ranked. Owns an actual gaming chair. Drives a Civic with a chrome bumper sticker that says something about 'the grind.'

name: Mii
text: You're a cop, or you wanted to be one. Either way, we're keeping an eye on you.

name: Morton
text: Big guy energy with surprising tenderness. Cooks better than anyone in the friend group. Makes his own salsa and brings it to gatherings unsolicited. King.

name: Pink Gold Peach
text: Maximalist. Owns two phones for unclear reasons. Has been to Vegas more than once this year. Bought crypto in 2021 and is, against all advice, still 'holding.'

name: Daisy
text: HII I'M DAISY!! Loud. Wholesome. Genuinely unhinged in the best possible way. Will scream sing in your car and you will allow it because she's correct.

name: Peach
text: Princess complex, fully self aware. Brunch enthusiast. Has more than three candles burning at any given moment. Bossy in a way that gets things done.

name: Rosalina
text: Spiritual but in a hot way. Reads tarot and takes it just seriously enough. Will explain Saturn return at the bar and you will listen because she is mesmerizing.

name: Roy
text: Frat energy that aged surprisingly well. Plays beer pong at a near professional level. Cries during the third Toy Story movie and is not ashamed about it.

name: Shy Guy
text: Mysterious by accident, not on purpose. Doesn't post. Knows everything about everyone in your friend group, which is honestly alarming when you think about it.

name: Tanooki Mario
text: Furry adjacent. We're not judging. (We are.) You have an OC and a fursona and at least one of them is a fox.

name: Toad
text: ANNOYING. Says 'let's gooooo' constantly. The friend group's hype man whether anyone asked or not. Beloved despite himself.

name: Toadette
text: Wholesome chaos. Bakes excellently. Has a Pinterest board for a wedding she has not been proposed for. Manifesting works for her, somehow, and it's infuriating.

name: Villager Female
text: Cottagecore. Owns chickens or wants to. Talks to her plants and they're thriving. Will quietly become the most successful person you know.

name: Villager Male
text: Dad jokes on demand. Owns a smoker and has Strong Opinions about the smoker. Knows three songs on guitar and will play all three at any function.

name: Waluigi
text: Funniest person you know. Bad credit. Will absolutely steal a fry off your plate without asking and you'll let him. Iconic. Underrated. Vindictive.

name: Wario
text: Crypto. Says 'money money money' unironically. Surprisingly excellent cook. Has been to a strip club 'for the wings.' We do not believe him.

name: Wendy
text: Pretty privilege, fully aware. Has an 11 step skincare routine. Will absolutely block you for a slight you do not remember committing.

name: Yoshi
text: Pure of heart. Eats too much candy. Will throw hands for his friends without hesitation. Best person you know, actually. We don't deserve him.
